summary: {employee} can tell a caller the city expects a higher fee before the new price is ready to quote.
realLife: Portland's June 2025 public rate notice said a tee fee increase was expected but did not yet give a final amount.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a public rate notice, proposed schedule and effective date.

turns.pulledBy: Only the direction of the increase has been announced.
turns.what: The employee gives the caller the existing price and explains when to check again.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry remains open for a confirmed rate.

turns.pulledBy: A later vote reduces the proposed charge.
turns.what: Staff correct the earlier estimate before taking payment.
turns.writesBack: The confirmation uses the adopted figure.
